annotation.title_clean: Report of the Global Forum for Road Traffic Safety on its seventy-seventh session — Annex 1: Resolution on the deployment of highly and fully automated vehicles in road traffic
annotation.title_en: Report of the Global Forum for Road Traffic Safety on its seventy-seventh session — Annex 1: Resolution on the deployment of highly and fully automated vehicles in road traffic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNECE Global Forum for Road Traffic Safety (WP.1)
annotation.venue: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (ECE/TRANS/WP.1/165)
annotation.summary_en: UNECE WP.1 session report containing Annex 1, a non-binding resolution adopted in 2018 on deploying highly and fully automated vehicles in road traffic. It gives recommendations for automated driving systems and their users, consistent with the 1949 and 1968 road traffic conventions. Only the table of contents and clause headings are in the excerpt.
key_provisions_or_claims: Non-binding resolution on deployment of highly and fully automated vehicles, adopted 2018
Recommendations for automated driving systems in road traffic
Recommendations for users of automated driving systems
Aims for consistency with the 1949 and 1968 Conventions on Road Traffic and WP.29 vehicle regulations
